description: President’s Day reminds us what kind of leadership built this country and what kind of character preserved it. George Washington gave us a nation. Abraham Lincoln kept it together. Here are the lessons their lives still teach us today.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Campaign to Elect Cory Maloy
title: President’s Day Message from Rep. Cory Maloy: What George Washington and Abraham Lincoln Still Teach Us | The 52 Report
